name: architect-pm-handoff
description: A Codex-only workflow for architecture planning, micro-batched Task Specs, and implementation review.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Task Specs and review implementation
interface.longDescription: Use Codex as the architecture and review role: inspect the repository, create small executable Task Specs for an implementation agent, and review the resulting changes without taking over implementation.
defaultPrompt: Use Architect PM Handoff to plan this requirement into executable Task Specs.
Use Architect PM Handoff to review the implementation report and diff for the current task.
